core_categories: Pharmaceuticals; OTC Medications; Parapharmaceuticals; Medical Devices; Surgical Products; Logistics Services
specialty_focus: Alliance Healthcare France is a major pharmaceutical wholesaler and distributor, operating as a subsidiary of Cencora. It specializes in reliable distribution and supply chain services for the French healthcare market, connecting drug manufacturers with retail pharmacies, hospitals, and healthcare providers. It distributes a range of products including pharmaceuticals, OTC medications, parapharmaceuticals, and medical devices, and also offers contract logistics and pre-wholesale services through entities like Alloga France.
